description: Monitor ICTContact / ICTDialer outbound campaigns, and start and stop them when writes are on.
name: io.github.ictinnovations/ictcontact-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of your ICTContact / ICTDialer server, without the /rest suffix, e.g. https://your-ictcontact.
environmentVariables.name: ICTCONTACT_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Unlocks starting and stopping campaigns, which begins live outbound calling and can cost money. When false those tools are not registered at all. Leave off unless you mean it.
environmentVariables.name: ICTCONTACT_MCP_ALLOW_WRITE

environmentVariables.description: Per request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.
environmentVariables.name: ICTCONTACT_TIMEOUT_MS

environmentVariables.description: Skip TLS certificate verification. Only for a self-signed test server.
environmentVariables.name: ICTCONTACT_TLS_INSECURE
